Mika: FYI kicking off KumoHealth private dry-run checklist. Please ack owners for each item below — image sync, DNS/firewall, canary, egress, KMS/HSM. I want async updates here.
Kevin: I can own image sync + signed bundle. Will do checksum verification after sync. ETA today EOD.
Anna: I'm on firewall/DNS. Need the final CIDR from Kumo to confirm rules. @Kevin can you confirm registry IP?
Kevin: yep registry will be 10.0.4.12:5000 (airgap mirror). Sharing the mirror script if helpful:
```
# mirror images to airgap registry
skopeo sync --dest docker docker://registry.redwood.io docker://10.0.4.12:5000 --all
```
Carla: I'll own canary deploy and smoke tests. Planning to run canary in staging-vpc-2 at 15:00 PT.
Mika: Quick note on egress: metrics collector stats endpoint is at 34.120.12.8:443 — canary nodes need outbound allowed. @Devin can you take this?
Devin: I can open egress for the canary subnet in staging, prod will need INF ticket. I opened INF-4823 for prod egress changes.
Carla: Smoke checklist I've got: healthz, kv-cache warm, token auth, basic DB connectivity (no migrations). Will post results after run.
deploy-bot: canary start triggered by Carla at 3123456833 — status: in_progress
Kevin: One blocker: Kumo uses a custom CA and expects signed certs. We need a cert rotation step + HSM import window. @Mika who handles the KMS/HSM handshake with the customer?
Mika: @Kevin I'll coordinate with security and the customer. Expect HSM key import window tomorrow morning (ETA 09:30 PT).
Anna: DNS glide: we'll add a private A record kumo.internal -> 10.0.4.12. @Carla can you validate TLS fingerprint after canary?
Carla: will validate. Test plan: curl + check TLS pubkey fingerprint, then run a 1k token generation smoke to ensure kv-cache warm.
Mika: Summarizing owners: image-sync=Kevin, firewall/DNS=Anna, canary=Carla, egress=Devin, kms/HSM=Security (coordinated by me). If anyone can't meet ETA call it out here.
Kevin: ETA holds, will post checksum when sync completes :thumbsup:
Devin: egress update: opened canary egress in staging, prod will follow after INF-4823 review :eyes:
Anna: DNS record added, waiting for TTL propagation. Ping me when canary runs so I can validate.
Carla: Canary started — smoke first pass green. Quick log: `curl -k https://10.0.4.12/healthz -> 200` and token auth check OK. Next: larger payloads and KV-warm timing.
Mika: Thanks all — leaving this thread for async updates. If we hit rollback criteria (healthz < 200 or auth fails) tag @oncall and post immediate rollback steps.
Kevin: posted image checksum and signed bundle: sha256:3f7a9... — copying to customer mirror now.
Devin: INF-4823 assigned to infra-sre for prod egress review. Will update here after review.
Anna: Verified TLS fingerprint against customer's CA chain, matches. No cert errors seen.
Carla: Running heavy-load smoke now, will report latencies and kv-cache hit rate.
Mika: Great. If anything blocks the canary we revert and mark the thread with `rollback` tag. Otherwise we'll promote after 3 successful smoke passes.
